opening.argument: The presentation promotes participation through purchased mining packages and token bundles, stating that tokens enable trading and earning money and that holding more tokens leads to more coins and greater earnings. It also ties participation to recruitment-based compensation, with a matching-bonus structure showing percentages across four generations. Alongside the signup route and paid packages, it promises repayment within 3–6 months and three- to tenfold capital growth in the first year. Those advertised returns, withdrawals, gold backing, and bonuses are not established as delivered.
